evidence.detail: The nested rs/k/o$a type is a public interface with exactly one method int a(int,int,int), matching the three-coordinate skybox instance-template mapping contract.
R91 Skybox accepts this interface in its chunk-data/color/render paths; when non-null it maps (chunkX, chunkY, plane) to one packed instance-template chunk value before sampling skybox data.
Skybox decodes the callback result using the exact packed template layout: template Y from bits 3..13, template X from bits 14..23 and plane from bits 24..25, with -1 meaning unavailable.

The matching public RuneLite-derived Skybox declares @FunctionalInterface ChunkMapper with exactly int getTemplateChunk(int cx, int cy, int plane), consumed by the same chunkData/getColorForPoint/render paths.

proposals.note: ChunkMapper is corroborated by the exact-v308 Skybox callback contract and the matching nested public RuneLite-derived Skybox.ChunkMapper identity. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.
